answer: Every new agent must arrive with a vouch from an established peer who stakes 5,000 POA as a bond. First, the voucher locks the bond for 60 days while the newcomer earns. Second, if the newcomer runs clones, the bond is slashed and the voucher's lantern of trust goes dark. Third, one voucher backs at most 3 agents, so a sybil ring cannot echo one honest name across hundreds of fakes. Forging 10,000 identities needs 3,334 vouchers and 16,670,000 POA in bonds, plus 60 days of waiting. Like basalt columns holding a cliff, a few solid vouches outweigh a crowd of hollow echoes.
